summary: In 2026 the enterprise AI model API landscape is dominated by hyperscaler-managed platforms that let corporations access frontier foundation models (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and more) through secure, governed APIs without data leaving their cloud environment. Frontier models accessed through these platforms land within a few points of each other on most production tasks, so there is no single winner — the best fit usually comes down to which cloud you already run, how strict your data-residency rules are, and which models you actually need. Choice is driven by cloud fit, existing contracts, data gravity, and compliance requirements rather than raw model quality.
why_enterprises_use_aggregators: Data residency and privacy: inference runs inside the company's own cloud tenant/VPC so proprietary data and prompts never leave the governed environment or get used for model training.
Compliance and certifications: platforms provide SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR and regional data-residency guarantees out of the box, which raw vendor APIs often lack.
Single billing and consolidated contracts: AI spend flows through existing cloud commitments (EDP/MACC), simplifying procurement, invoicing, and budget drawdown.
Model choice and avoiding lock-in: one managed API exposes many models from different providers, so teams can switch or compare models without re-architecting integrations.
Enterprise controls and governance: built-in audit logs, IAM/RBAC, private networking, content guardrails, and observability that integrate with the company's existing security stack.

platforms.name: Azure OpenAI Service
available_models: selected open models via Azure AI Foundry (Llama, Mistral, Cohere)
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per 1K/1M tokens plus Provisioned Throughput Units (PTUs) for reserved capacity; consumption draws down Azure MACC commitments.
key_features: deep Microsoft 365 and Entra ID integration
platforms.best_for: Microsoft-centric enterprises wanting the strongest OpenAI model access with enterprise terms and tight M365/Azure integration.

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per token with on-demand pricing plus Provisioned Throughput for reserved/guaranteed capacity; flows through AWS EDP commitments.
platforms.best_for: AWS-native enterprises wanting the widest multi-vendor model choice with strong agent and RAG tooling.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI Model Garden
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per token/character plus Provisioned Throughput; draws down Google Cloud committed-use/contract spend.
platforms.best_for: Google-native workloads and teams needing long-context models and tight BigQuery/data-analytics integration.

platforms.name: Snowflake Cortex AI
compliance: regional data residency per Snowflake account region
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based using Snowflake credits; introduced separate AI credits starting April 1, 2026 priced at $2.00 per credit globally.
key_features: AI runs next to governed data in-platform
platforms.best_for: Enterprises with Snowflake-centered data estates wanting AI applied directly to governed data without moving it.

platforms.name: IBM watsonx.ai
platforms.pricing: Capacity/resource-unit based consumption plus subscription tiers; available on IBM Cloud and hybrid/on-prem via Cloud Pak.
platforms.best_for: Regulated enterprises needing hybrid/on-prem deployment, strong governance programs, and existing IBM skills.

platforms.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Generative AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per character/token plus dedicated AI clusters for reserved capacity; integrates with OCI Universal Credits.
key_features: sovereign cloud and EU sovereign regions
platforms.best_for: Oracle-centric and sovereignty-focused enterprises embedding AI into Oracle Database, Fusion, and ERP workloads.

platforms.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per request/neuron with generous free tier; usage-based serverless billing.
platforms.best_for: Developers and enterprises needing low-latency edge inference, open-source models, and serverless scale close to users.

platforms.name: OpenRouter
available_models: 300+ models: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, and more via unified API
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go pass-through pricing per token with a small routing markup; credit-based prepay.
platforms.best_for: Developers and teams wanting one API to compare and switch across the broadest set of models with pay-as-you-go flexibility.
